fee_notes: Royalty is flat $300/month per territory up to 200,000 population, then +$1.50 per 1,000 persons over 200k; max 10% annual increase. Advertising fee up to $100/month not currently collected. Website/Software fee $200-$700/month (mid=$450). No royalty percentage of gross sales.
